title: x-happyvertical compose deployment contract, version 1
description: Extension fields that turn a Compose file into an application deployment declaration. The root schema checks the annotations of a whole Compose document and leaves every Compose key alone. Use #/$defs/application for the top-level block and #/$defs/service for a service block on their own. Rules that span several services (one web service, one ingress port, the supported platform subset) are checked by validateComposeDeployment() in @happyvertical/smrt-config/deployment, not by this schema.

serviceName.description: A Compose service name the platform can use as a resource name.

command.description: A command in list form, one argument per item. It is run as written, without a shell.

version.description: Contract version. This schema describes version 1.

preset.description: Which platform preset fills in the rest of the deployment.

domain.description: The hostname the application wants to be served on. Lowercase, no scheme, port or path.

migrate.description: How database migrations run before a release starts serving.

service.description: The web or worker service whose image runs the migration. Defaults to the web service.

health.description: How the platform decides a service is ready: an HTTP path on the ingress port, or a command run inside the container.

path.description: Path answered with a 2xx status when the service is ready.

service.description: A service-level x-happyvertical block. A service is either something the application runs (role) or a stand-in for a platform service (binding), never both.

role.description: web serves HTTP on the one ingress port. worker runs in the background and serves nothing.

binding.description: The platform service this local container stands in for.
